lines.text: A ring rolls all the way around inside a big hoop.
lines.caption: A ring rolls all the way around inside a big hoop.

lines.text: Lots of people guess five turns. But it's NOT five!
lines.caption: Lots of people guess five turns. But it's NOT five!

lines.text: The ring has radius two, and the hoop has radius ten.
lines.caption: The ring has radius two, and the hoop has radius ten.

lines.text: How many full turns does the ring make on one trip around?
lines.caption: How many full turns does the ring make on one trip around?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Follow the center of the ring!
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Follow the center of the ring!

lines.text: It stays two from the hoop, so it travels a circle of radius eight.
lines.caption: It stays two from the hoop, so it travels a circle of radius eight.

lines.text: Each full turn moves the center one rim length, four pi.
lines.caption: Each full turn moves the center one rim length, four pi.

lines.text: That circle is sixteen pi long. Sixteen pi over four pi gives the turns.
lines.caption: That circle is sixteen pi long. Sixteen pi over four pi gives the turns.

lines.text: The dot touches the hoop five times, but the loop takes one turn back.
lines.caption: The dot touches the hoop five times, but the loop takes one turn back.

lines.text: Why one back? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why one back? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
